name: 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash
subtitle: For Mild Occasional Acne | Oily Skin Type | Suitable for 13+ yrs
usageInstructions: Use twice a day, morning & evening. Pump out a coin size, work up a mild lather and massage your face in gentle, anti-clockwise circular movements for 60 seconds. Rinse with lukewarm or tap water and pat dry your face with a clean towel.
